title: Python environment in Paseo worktrees
description: Appends uv sync to the Paseo worktree setup, after the mise step, so each worktree starts with the Python environment synced from uv.lock, since .venv is gitignored.

context_before: "cd \"$PASEO_SOURCE_CHECKOUT_PATH\" && for f in .env .env.* mise.local.toml .claude/settings.local.json; do [ ! -f \"$f\" ] || [ -e \"$PASEO_WORKTREE_PATH/$f\" ] || { mkdir -p \"$(dirname \"$PASEO_WORKTREE_PATH/$f\")\" && cp -p \"$f\" \"$PASEO_WORKTREE_PATH/$f\"; } || exit 1; done",
